name: High Voltage Electric Shock Device for Self Defence (801 Type
description:
High Voltage Output – Delivers a powerful electric shock to disable attackers.
Rechargeable Battery – Built-in battery with charging cable.
LED Flashlight – Bright light for night-time use.
Compact & Portable – Easy to carry and store.
Easy Operation – Simple switch mechanism for quick activation.
Non-Lethal Protection – Temporarily incapacitates attackers without permanent harm.
Durable Build – Made from sturdy materials for long-term use.
Key Features:
High Voltage Output – Generates a powerful electric shock, effectively immobilizing attackers.
Rechargeable Battery – Built-in rechargeable lithium battery with a long-lasting charge.
LED Flashlight – Integrated bright LED light for night-time visibility and emergency use.
Compact & Portable – Small, lightweight, and easy to carry in a pocket, purse, or bag.
Easy to Use – Simple switch mechanism for quick activation in emergency situations.
Non-Lethal Protection – Disorients and incapacitates attackers without causing permanent injury.
Durable & Shockproof Build – Made from high-quality materials for long-term reliability.
Anti-Slip Grip – Ergonomic design ensures a firm hold during use.
Voltage Output: Typically between 800,000V – 1,000,000V (varies by manufacturer).
Power Source: Built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery.
Charging Time: 3 to 5 hours for a full charge.
Flashlight: Bright LED light for low-light situations.
Material: Durable ABS plastic with anti-slip grip.
Dimensions: Approximately 16 cm x 5 cm x 3 cm.
Weight: 200-300 grams, making it lightweight and easy to handle.
